about.title: About us
about.body: ChePagame is a free app to split expenses among friends, family, couples or flatmates. Every expense is recorded, balances are calculated exactly in each Account's currency and you always know who owes whom.
about.why: Because splitting costs shouldn't end in an argument. It was born in Argentina to make paying your share simple and transparent, without spreadsheets or math on napkins.
about.privacy: No ads and no data sales. You can export everything whenever you want and delete your account at any time.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers on splitting expenses and keeping accounts clear with ChePagame.

what.a: An app to split group expenses. Everyone adds what they paid and ChePagame works out who owes whom, to the cent.

free.a: Yes. ChePagame is free and has no ads.

app.a: We are preparing the Android app. Meanwhile, the Web works in your phone's browser and you can add it to your home screen.

create.q: How do I create a shared account?
create.a: Go to Accounts, tap New Account, give it a name (for example, Trip to Bariloche), choose the currency and add the participants.

invite.q: How do I invite the group?
invite.a: From the Account, share the invitation link on WhatsApp or anywhere. Whoever opens it joins and picks which participant they are.

currency.a: Each Account has its own currency, chosen when you create it. All its expenses and balances use that currency.

split.a: You choose who paid, the amount and who shares it. The amount is split equally among the chosen people.

cents.a: If the amount doesn't split evenly, the extra cent goes to one person following the Account's order, so the shares always add up to the total.

who.a: Any member of the Account. Every change is recorded with who made it and when.

owes.q: How do I know who owes whom?
owes.a: Balances shows how much each person is owed or owes, and ChePagame suggests the fewest payments to settle everyone.

settle.q: What is a payment between members?
settle.a: When someone pays money back to another member. Recording it updates the balances and lowers the debt.

income.q: How do I record that someone paid me back?
income.a: In the Account's expense list tap Income, choose who paid and how much. It lowers the debt between you and also shows in Balances.

close.q: Can I close an Account when the trip is over?
close.a: Yes. The Owner can close it: it becomes read-only and its expenses and balances stay visible.

data.a: Your email, your name if you add it, your preferences and what you add to your Accounts. We don't sell data or show ads.

export.a: Yes. From your Profile or from each Account you can download your data as CSV or JSON.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: From Profile, in Delete my account. You confirm with a code sent to your email and your personal data is deleted.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data ChePagame keeps and what it does with it.

data.title: What data we keep
data.body: Your email, your first and last name if you add them, your preferences (language, default currency and theme) and what you add to your accounts: participants, expenses, settlements and their changes.

use.title: What we use it for
use.body: Only to make the app work: identify you, show your accounts and calculate balances. We use no advertising or analytics tools, and we never sell or share your data.

members.title: Who sees your data
members.body: The members of an account see what that account holds: participants, expenses, settlements and balances. Nobody outside the account can see it.

providers.title: External services
providers.body: If you sign in with Google, Google confirms your identity to us. Emails with access codes are sent through an email delivery provider, which only receives your address and the message.

history.title: Change history
history.body: Changes to expenses and settlements are recorded so members can see who changed what. Deleted items are no longer shown, but they are kept in the history.

export.title: Your data is yours
export.body: You can download all your data as CSV or JSON from your Profile, under Export my data, and each account from its own page.

delete.title: Delete your data
delete.body: You can delete your account at any time from your Profile, under Delete my account, or by following the steps at chepagame.com.ar/delete-account. Your email, your name, your preferences and your sessions are erased. What you added to shared accounts stays for the other members, without your name.

device.title: Preferences on your device
device.body: We keep the language and theme you choose in your browser or in the App, so the site looks the way you left it even when you are not signed in. They are strictly functional: they identify no one and are never shared with third parties.

thirdParties.title: Contact and anti-bot check
thirdParties.body: If you write to us from the contact form and agree to it, your name, email and message are sent by WhatsApp to the project's maintainer through CallMeBot; we don't store them. Sign-up and the contact form use Cloudflare Turnstile to stop bots: Cloudflare processes technical data from your browser only for that check.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: If you have questions about your data, write to us from the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: By using ChePagame you accept these terms.

service.title: What ChePagame is
service.body: A tool to record shared expenses and work out who owes whom. The app does not move money: payments between participants happen outside of it.

access.title: Your access
access.body: You are responsible for keeping access to your email or Google account safe, and for what you add to your accounts.

balances.title: Balances
balances.body: Balances are calculated from the amounts members enter. Check them before paying or collecting.

data.title: Your data
data.body: The data you add is yours and you can export it whenever you want. How we handle it is explained on the Privacy page.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. The date of the last update is shown at the bottom of this page.

donate.title: Support ChePagame
donate.body: ChePagame is free and has no ads. If it helps you, you can support it with a contribution.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.profileHint: Erases your personal data from ChePagame. It cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.intro: Before confirming, check what is erased and what stays. You can download your data first.
deleteAccount.erasedBody: Your email, your first and last name, your password, your preferences, the link to Google and all your sessions. Accounts where you are the only registered member are deleted with their expenses.
deleteAccount.keptBody: In the accounts you share with other people, your expenses and settlements stay so balances do not change. There you will show up as “Deleted user”. If you were the owner, the member who joined first becomes the owner.
deleteAccount.exportHint: Download your profile and your accounts before deleting your account. You cannot do it afterwards.
deleteAccount.codeSentTo: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it to delete your account.
deleteAccount.irreversible: Once you enter the code, your account is deleted right away and it cannot be undone.

deleteAccountPage.title: Delete your ChePagame account
deleteAccountPage.intro: You can delete your account from the web, even if you no longer have the App installed.
deleteAccountPage.step1: Sign in at chepagame.com.ar with your email or with Google.
deleteAccountPage.step2: Go to Profile → Delete my account and ask for the code.
deleteAccountPage.step3: Enter the code you get by email. The account is deleted right then.
deleteAccountPage.noAccess: No longer have access to your email? Write to us from the Contact page.
